items.title: IT's time to celebrate when chips are down; Nifty IT soars 11.7% to log biggest weekly rally since 2008
items.description: The Indian IT sector experienced an impressive surge, achieving its highest weekly increase in 18 years, driven by unexpectedly strong quarterly results from companies like HCLTech. The Nifty IT index jumped 11.7%, amidst falling semiconductor stock prices in Asia. Furthermore, the rupee showed notable strength, closing below the 95-mark for the first time in 38 days, reflecting the effective measures implemented by the Reserve Bank of India.

items.title: 5 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 29 % in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: Look at how the market treated the stock of a large FMCG stock – one the best wealth creators of the past – just because it mentioned the risk of rising input costs. It shows what the underlying sentiment on the street is like.
